note: Rules chosen by the team for the demonstration. They are NOT medical protocols, NOT NASA flight rules and NOT scientific references. Scientific reference values are in nasa_reference.json; indicative colour bands are in thresholds.json.

earth_report.rule: A report is queued for Earth when at least one indicator is in its critical band, or when two or more indicators are red at the same time. A single red reading outside a critical band stays with the crew.

exercise.rule: The exercise minutes of a check-in are the total for that calendar day (UTC) so far. The latest check-in of a day replaces the earlier ones. A streak counts days, not check-ins.

freshness.rule: A zone whose most recent reading is older than this is shown as 'no recent data', not as its last colour. The cumulative radiation dose is exempt: it is a running total, not a reading taken at check-in.

meals.rule: A logged meal removes real portions from the stock. A box on the demo shelf stands for a whole storage lot (food_item.units_per_lot portions); only a shelf scan adds or removes lots.
